Lenovo is a US$83 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked #153 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world’s largest PC company with a full-stack portfolio of AI-enabled, AI-ready, and AI-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo’s continued investment in world-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. Lenovo is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange under Lenovo Group Limited (HKSE: 992) (ADR: LNVGY). This transformation together with Lenovo’s world-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub. Position Overview Lenovo seeks a Systems Administrator to own end-to-end deployment, support, and administration of hybrid cloud and AI infrastructure primarily for the Bangalore lab, across the network, compute, storage, operating system, and container orchestration (Docker and Kubernetes) layers, plus the NVIDIA technology stack. You are a dedicated support resource for the Lab Operations Manager and you keep hybrid cloud and AI infrastructure operational in Bangalore at the scale the AI Lab Consolidation requires. You coordinate remotely with the Morrisville-based Systems Administrator, GPU/AI Infrastructure, Network Engineer on shared standards, escalations, and cross-site incident response, and you provide secondary technical support back to Morrisville. The role sits within Lenovo SSG’s Hybrid Cloud and AI Infrastructure Services (HCAIS) Offering Architecture Engineering organization. Key Responsibilities Infrastructure Deployment and Administration Network: deploy, support, and administer lab networking for the Bangalore site. Compute: deploy, support, and administer physical and virtual compute infrastructure across the Bangalore lab. Storage: deploy, support, and administer lab storage systems across block and file tiers. Operating Systems: install, patch, and administer operating systems across Bangalore lab infrastructure. Hybrid Cloud Platform Administration VMware: deploy, support, and administer VMware virtualization infrastructure (vSphere, ESXi, vCenter). Azure: support hybrid cloud integration and workloads extending Bangalore lab infrastructure to Microsoft Azure. Nutanix: deploy, support, and administer Nutanix hyperconverged infrastructure (HCI). Red Hat OpenShift: deploy, support, and administer Red Hat OpenShift container platform environments, extending the lab’s container orchestration footprint. Container Orchestration Docker: deploy and administer Docker container runtime environments. Kubernetes: own full production Kubernetes administration, including cluster operations, role-based access control (RBAC), cluster networking, and version upgrades. NVIDIA Platform Administration NVIDIA Technology Stack: administer NVIDIA drivers, the CUDA toolkit, InfiniBand fabric, Run:AI orchestration, and ClearML across the Bangalore lab’s GPU infrastructure. Configuration Validation: validate lab configurations against NVIDIA reference architecture (Lenovo Validated Design) certification requirements. Lab Operations and Smart Hands Equipment Support: provide on-site, hands-on technical support for capital equipment requested by the Bangalore Professional Services / LMS team. Day-to-Day Support: provide day-to-day administration, support, and engineering functions for the network, compute, and storage layers in the physical Bangalore lab. Rack and Stack: perform rack-and-stack, structured cabling, imaging, and smart-hands support for lab hardware alongside higher-level administration duties. Cross-Site Support and Coordination Morrisville Secondary Support: provide secondary technical support for NVIDIA technology stack capital equipment hosted in Morrisville. Remote Coordination: coordinate remotely with the Morrisville-based Systems Administrator, GPU/AI Infrastructure, Network Engineer, and Junior Systems Administrator on shared standards, escalations, and incident response across a roughly 12-hour time zone gap. NVIDIA Relationship: maintain a working relationship with NVIDIA field contacts, coordinating remotely with the Morrisville-based team. Required Qualifications Required Experience 4+ years of systems administration experience with hands-on breadth across network, compute, storage, and operating system layers, plus a GPU/AI infrastructure specialization. Hybrid Cloud Platforms: hands-on experience with hybrid cloud platforms such as VMware (vSphere/ESXi/vCenter), Microsoft Azure, Nutanix HCI, or Red Hat OpenShift. Hybrid Cloud or AI Certification: NVIDIA NCP-AI or equivalent in Microsoft or Red Hat OpenShift. Production Kubernetes Administration: demonstrated experience with cluster operations, RBAC, cluster networking, and version upgrades in a production environment. Docker: hands-on experience administering Docker container runtime environments. Hands-on NVIDIA administration: demonstrated experience administering NVIDIA drivers and the CUDA toolkit. Physical Infrastructure: comfortable with hands-on hardware work, including rack-and-stack, structured cabling, and smart hands, in addition to higher-level administration. Core Professional Skills Incident Response: able to own after-hours incident response for a shared, multi-team infrastructure environment. Independent Ownership: comfortable working as the senior on-site infrastructure owner in Bangalore, remotely coordinating with the Morrisville-based team across a significant time zone gap. Physical Presence: this role requires physical, on-site presence in Bangalore and cannot be performed remotely from elsewhere. Preferred Qualifications Multi-Tenant Lab Experience: experience supporting a multi-tenant shared lab environment serving distributed teams. Experience with DCIM, IPAM, or monitoring tooling comparable to the lab’s stack (Hyperview-class DCIM, BlueCat / Infoblox-class IPAM, NVIDIA DCGM monitoring). InfiniBand Fabric: working familiarity with InfiniBand fabric in a multi-node GPU environment. GPU Orchestration: experience with Run:AI, ClearML, or a comparable GPU orchestration and MLOps toolset. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any federal, state, or local protected class.

review_candidates.title: Senior DevOps/Infrastructure Engineer
review_candidates.description: About The Role As a Senior DevOps/Infrastructure Engineer at Thndr, you'll be part of our fast-growing fintech team . We are looking for someone who can bring deep expertise and hands-on experience in cloud infrastructure, containerization, networking, and DevOps best practices . The ideal candidate will be a strategic thinker, capable of designing, implementing, and guiding a robust DevOps and infrastructure roadmap across both cloud and on-premise environments. You will play a critical role in building scalable, resilient, and secure systems that support our mission-critical financial applications. What You'll Do Architect, implement, and maintain scalable, secure, and highly available infrastructure across AWS and on-premise environments. Lead containerization and orchestration strategy using Docker and Kubernetes, ensuring deployment, scaling, and security best practices. Design and manage complex networking solutions, including VPCs, subnets, routing, firewalls, VPNs, load balancers, PrivateLinks, Direct Connect, and AWS Secure VPN setup, as well as hybrid cloud connectivity. Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for applications and infrastructure, including automated testing and deployment. Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code for scalable, multi-region infrastructures using multilevel Terraform and Terragrunt, ensuring modularity, version control, and automation. Implement monitoring, observability, and alerting for all infrastructure components, with a mindset of proactive issue detection and response. Collaborate with development, security, data teams to ensure smooth production releases. Mentor and guide junior DevOps engineers on best practices across cloud, networking, DevOps, and monitoring disciplines. Ability to build deep context across multiple domains (Infrastructure, development, security, operations) to design cohesive, scalable DevOps solutions. Drive DevOps initiatives by connecting technical, business, and operational perspectives to ensure scalable, secure, and efficient infrastructure delivery. What You'll Need Strong hands-on expertise in AWS services (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, IAM, CloudFormation, networking services). Deep knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes (EKS or equivalent) for containerized applications. Solid understanding of networking concepts (TCP/IP, routing, DNS, firewalls, VPNs, load balancing) in cloud and on-prem environments. Proven experience in designing and implementing DevOps strategies and infrastructure roadmaps. Strong scripting skills (Python, Bash, or equivalent) for automation. Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI. Knowledge of security best practices and fintech compliance standards Who Are We? Thndr was founded on a bold dream to democratize access to investing through smart tech and human-centric design. This is simply our way of saying we give anyone with a smartphone the simple and easy access they need to preserve and grow their wealth. At the same time, we’re shaping the future of investing while actively driving the economies we serve by promoting local investment products. History has shown that investing is the single greatest way to build long-term wealth, but before Thndr , only a very small percentage of people had access to it due to: High barriers to entry — In the form of excessive minimum account balances, complex, outdated onboarding, and low financial literacy. Irrelevant experience — Catered toward expert traders and financial specialists, therefore alienating the majority of the population. Fragmented offering — Investment products were not gathered in a single, intuitive outlet. We don't just talk about change, we deliver it. Here's a glimpse into our impact so far: 5.5 million app downloads EGP 1B+ average daily traded value across 2025 #1 digital investing platform in Egypt for the third consecutive year 76% of users are first-time investors 40% of our users come from outside of capital cities and have previously had limited access to financial institutions Building on the success of our core platform, we are continuing to change culture and break down barriers by launching Rumble , the subscription-based investment recommendations platform. Rumble was born with the vision to empower everyday individuals to build wealth confidently and intelligently through access to timely and in-depth advice from the industry’s top experts. Going beyond traditional investment advice, it offers long and short-term investment recommendations and financial content through engaging articles and videos that guide users on their financial journey and maximize their returns. At Thndr , we're looking for people driven by our mission to help us democratize investing across the MENA region.
